```{r}
library(redivis)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(glue)
library(forcats)
library(purrr)

org <- redivis$organization("levante")
params <- org$dataset("levante_metadata_scoring:e97h",
                      version = "next")$table("item_parameters")$to_tibble()
items <- params |>
  rename(language = subset) |>
  mutate(language = na_if(language, "all_items")) |>
  mutate(item_group = if_else(is.na(item_group), task_code, item_group),
         item_group_label = if_else(is.na(item_group_label), task_code, item_group_label)) |>
  arrange(task_label)

file_link <- \(file_id, version) glue("https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/e97h-009zz0c49/files/{file_id}?v={version}")

models <- items |>
  select(task_code, language, itemtype, registry_version = model_registry_version,
           n_runs = model_n_runs, added_at, file_id) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(registry_version = registry_version |> str_remove("^v") |> str_replace_all("_", "."),
         file_link = map2_chr(file_id, registry_version, file_link)) |>
  mutate(itemtype = itemtype |> fct_recode("Rasch" = "rasch", "2PL" = "2pl"),
         invariance_label = if_else(!is.na(language), "by language", "scalar invariant"))

# pass to OJS
ojs_define(items_ = items)
ojs_define(models_ = models)
```
